children.game_version: Animal imitation game where children take turns portraying ostriches, meerkats, or horses to the drumbeat.

seniors.seated_version: Perform hand-slapping askoek movements and hat-sweeping vlerksleep courtship gestures while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform trotting footwork and hat gestures at a reduced tempo near a support rail without jumps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower pace with moderate arm motions.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Mimicry of wings ('vlerksleep'), hat-holding, and hand-slapping the leg above the knee.
movement_profile.footwork: Ingenious and frantic footwork designed to kick up dust ('Dans lat die stof so staan'), including trotting, strutting, and cross-knee leg positioning.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group performed in a circle around a campfire or dusty performance space.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Dynamic movement imitating gamboling ('bokspring') and animal courtship poses.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes gamboling jumps ('bokspring') and crouched animal imitations.
movement_profile.partnering: Male and female courtship pair interaction using hat or coat props.

signature_moves.description: Courtship gesture using a coat panel, arm, or hat to invite a lady to dance.
signature_moves.name: vlerksleep

signature_moves.description: Placing one foot securely above the opposite knee and slapping it to imitate dusting ash off bread.
signature_moves.name: askoek slap

signature_moves.description: Gamboling and hopping moves mimicking energetic animal leaps.
signature_moves.name: bokspring

music_profile.sound_description: Lively boeremusiek featuring fast acoustic accompaniment led by the distinctive metallic resonance of the tin-can ramkie, accordion, and mouth organ.

basic_steps: Frantic dust-kicking footwork at an energetic pace
Bokspring (gamboling) and horse-like trotting or strutting
Vlerksleep courtship gesture using coat panel, arm, or hat to invite partner
Askoek slap placing right foot above left knee and slapping to dust off ash
teaching.level_notes: Requires high cardiovascular endurance, rapid foot agility, and expressive mimicry.
teaching.rhythm: Fast-paced lively beat derived from boeremusiek and folk tunes
